payload.title: isolated-implementer worktree cannot be placed off the plan's line by the agent definition
payload.body: Ruled: the worktree the harness gives the implementer starts off the plan's line wherever the harness can be made to do so (on Claude Code the worktree's creation can be hooked or its base configured); 'off that line' is part of the same clause as 'isolated', and a worktree cut from main is refused at land by isolated-landing, so starting off main only wastes the build. Where a harness cannot place the worktree (omp gives none), the agent's own competence and the land gate carry it. Realized by isolated-implementer, re-planned.
